artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.8 x 15.8 cm (6 1/4 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a kneeling figure in a robe, another figure with wings, and a celestial figure overhead. The central figure stands in a body of water, draped in cloth, receiving a blessing gesture from another figure standing on a rocky bank. An angelic figure is also present, holding a cloth, with a serene expression. Above them, in the clouds, is a divine being observing the scene. The background shows a landscape with water and rolling hills. The drawing is intricate, with detailed line work and hatching.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image shows a man on a cross with arms outstretched, wearing a crown of thorns. A group of people surrounds the base of the cross. One woman appears mourning on the left, while different individuals, including one kneeling, are depicted on the right. The background features rock formations and a landscape. The scene is rendered in a style emphasizing line and texture, with no visible color, and a skull and rocks are on the ground beneath the cross.

artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.1 x 17.2 cm (10 1/4 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of a group scene in an interior setting. The image depicts a crowded room where multiple figures are gathered around a central figure lying on a bed. The figures are intricately detailed, with careful attention given to the expressions and garments of each person. The central figure appears to be in a state of rest or unwell, as others engage in reading or observation around her. Curtains hang above and around the bed, adding a sense of intimacy and seclusion to the scene. The composition features rich textures, especially in the flowing drapery and hair of the individuals present. There is an intricate candlestick at the forefront. The initials "M + S" at the bottom indicate a signature mark.

artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows several figures gathered around a bed. A woman is reclining on the bed under a canopy, surrounded by multiple people, mostly men, with different facial hairstyles and head coverings. The setting includes flowing drapery, a decorative canopy, and a candlestick with an unlit candle. Detailed fabric textures are emphasized throughout, and the background depicts other figures within the interior space.

artworks.title: Christ Blessing the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.2 x 15.4 cm (6 3/8 x 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: Two figures are seated from the knees up. The person on the left has hands clasped in front, long hair, a robe, and a crown. The figure on the right has one hand raised and the other holds a globe with a cross on top, a beard, curly hair, a robe, and a crown. Surrounding them are five angels with wings and different expressions. The background includes architectural elements and halos behind the figures' heads.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure praying before a rocky formation with others nearby. The central figure is clothed in draped garments, kneeling with hands clasped in prayer against a large rock formation. To the left, a twisted and barren tree is visible against a jagged landscape. At the base of the rock, three figures appear to be in a reclining state, each with detailed expressions. On top of the rock, another small figure interacts with the praying figure. In the background, a group of armed figures can be seen advancing. Fine lines and detailed shading are used throughout, emphasizing textures in clothing, facial expressions, and the rocky environment.

artworks.title: The Betrayal and Capture of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an intense scene featuring individuals with various weapons. One central figure is bound with rope, surrounded by others in what seems to be a procession. Another figure is on the ground holding a staff. The artwork includes detailed clothing with patterns and a stark tree in the background. The composition is in black and white with strong lines, typical of early woodcut or engraving works.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures involved in a scene of flagellation. In the foreground, a central nude figure is bound to a column, surrounded by other figures, some of whom are holding whips or rods. The composition is intricate, with detailed lines depicting the muscles, expressions, and flowing garments of the figures. The setting is an architectural structure defined by arches and a column, and there are various objects on the floor including a cloth and a tool. The scene is energetic, with dynamic postures of the figures and dramatic use of light and shadow created by the detailed line work. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.5 x 11.7 cm (6 1/2 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a historical scene. The central figure is seated on a chair while another person pours water on their hands. Surrounding them are figures in elaborate clothing, some with armor and weapons. Two small dogs are also depicted in the scene. The drawing is rich in detail and depth, with a dynamic composition.

artworks.title: The Bearing of the Cross with Saint Veronica
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a dramatic biblical scene. One central figure is carrying a large wooden cross. Surrounding this figure are multiple others. The scene takes place in front of a large gate with pointed spikes. The detailed lines and shading create a striking contrast between the figures and the background, capturing a moment of intensity and emotion.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. A figure holds a cross-staff, surrounded by various beings, some of which appear demonic. The central figure is in a graceful pose, stepping on a figure with animalistic features. The figure holds a cross-topped staff and is clothed in flowing robes. Behind this figure, several nude individuals with expressions of pleading or surprise are reaching towards the central figure. A chaotic scene unfolds above them, as a devilish creature with many horns raises what seems to be a weapon. The drawing is detailed, with intricate linework capturing fabric folds, expressions, and movement. Shadows and cross-hatching add depth. The composition suggests a moment of salvation or confrontation, rendered in a style characteristic of Renaissance religious art.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child on a Grassy Bench
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a child on her lap. The woman is facing forward, with long hair flowing down her back. Her facial expression is serene. She wears a headdress and a long robe. The child reaches towards the woman. There is a fence-like structure around them, with a bare tree, hills, and a building in the background.

artworks.title: Madonna with a Parrot
artworks.description: The image shows two figures closely positioned. The person on the left is sitting and holding a book. She has long, flowing hair with soft curls and delicate facial features. She wears a long gown with voluminous sleeves. The child on her right is seated on her lap and is nude, looking at a bird on its hand. The child has curly hair and chubby cheeks. The background shows a textured wall or curtain with a window or framed panel, revealing a small tree outside. A pillow with ornate detailing supports the child.

artworks.title: Madonna on the Crescent
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.2 x 10.8 cm (6 3/4 x 4 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child in her arms. The woman has long, wavy hair, and the child has curly hair. They are both shown from the waist up and the woman is looking down at the child. The woman is wearing a long garment and a veil over her head, standing over a crescent. Two angels above them are holding part of an ornate crown over the woman's head. The background includes lines radiating from the figures and a few clouds beneath the crescent.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing upright. He has a long beard and curly hair, with deep-set eyes and arched eyebrows. He wears a long robe and holds a book in his left hand and a staff in his right hand. The background is neutral and sparse, with initials at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing upright, holding a staff in his right hand and a rolled manuscript in his left hand. The man has curly hair, a full beard, and wears a long robe. He stands barefoot on the ground. The background is plain, and there are markings at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Judas Thaddaeus
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright with unruly, curly hair and a full beard. He is wearing a long robe or cloak, and holding a staff. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: This print shows a man in full-length side profile, facing the left. He is standing with one hand resting on a ledge and the other hand holding a book close to his face. The man has long wavy hair and a full beard. He is dressed in a long robe that covers him entirely, reaching down to his bare feet. He stands on a mound-like surface. The background is plain. The print is on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a long beard and curly hair standing upright. He is dressed in a robe with a cloak over his shoulders. The man is holding a staff with a double cross and a bell. A wild boar stands near his feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Tribulations of Saint Anthony
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 31.5 x 23.2 cm (12 3/8 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines, crosshatching, and flicks of stippling, a bearded man wearing a long robe is being held up in the sky by nine nightmarish, extremely imaginative creatures in this vertical print. The man is balding and wrinkles line his high forehead. His body faces us, and his arms are pulled down by his sides. He looks down and off to our right with hooded eyes under a furrowed brow. A book hangs from a belt wrapped around his waist, and drapery flutters behind his right arm, to our left. The critters pull on his clothing, arms, legs, and hair. Three raise clubs, ready to strike. Each creature is unique, and they are made of intricate blends of feathers and fur, spikes and scales, snotus and beaks, blunt and sharp teeth, horns, wings, whiskers, flicking tongues, and fins. A bit of a rocky cliff edges into the lower right corner, and the top half of the sky has a loose pattern of horizontal dashes. The artist signed the lower center with his initials, “M + S.”

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.9 x 11.3 cm (6 1/4 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a beard wading through water with the help of a staff. He is accompanied by a small child on his shoulder. In the background, there is a figure in a hooded robe holding a lantern on the rocky bank. The surrounding landscape features rocky formations and mountains in the distance, all depicted in a monochromatic style typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.description: The image shows a knight on a horse fighting a dragon. The scene depicts a knight clad in armor riding a horse, attacking a dragon with a lance. In the background, a figure stands near a rocky outcrop watching the battle. The drawing emphasizes themes of chivalry and heroism, with detailed linework and shading providing depth to the composition.
